Established ideal/antichain edge criteria and integer BFS give exact graph diameters. The source independently proves the representative diameters (2,3). No floating point or sample extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: The first dimension in which Ehrhart- and edge-count-equivalent poset polytopes can have different one-skeleton diameters is a natural geometric-combinatorial obstruction problem raised by Lee’s 2026 examples. A complete minimal-size classification up to duality, with no excluded seven-element exceptions, provides a reusable sharp cutoff and rigorous finite obstruction census. This is not a routine rescaling or a mere recomputation of the known witness.
